svg.title: Sampling and quantizing a wave
svg.desc: A smooth curve, the pressure at the microphone, is measured at 24 evenly spaced instants. Each measurement is rounded to the nearest of 8 levels (3 bits), shown as green dots on horizontal lines. Underneath, the resulting list of integers. The horizontal spacing is set by the sample rate, the vertical spacing by the bit depth.
svg.text: From a smooth wave to a list of integers
what the converter writes down: one integer per instant
